notes: execution_count records the publication's run count, not the number of empirical samples provided: published tables expose summary statistics only.
For pqm4 mean timing: milliseconds = cycles / (clock_mhz * 1000). Source minimum and maximum are metadata; they are not sampled as if they were raw data.

embedded_reference.label: Published embedded composite with explicit Falcon / SLH lineage proxies
embedded_reference.platform: Mixed: P-256 nRF52840 at 64 MHz; PQ reference Cortex-M4 at 24 MHz
limitations: Composite of different platforms and implementations, not a single measured aircraft or receiver.
Published means or rounded estimates are repeated constants, not empirical distributions or worst-case execution times.
59-byte PQ benchmark messages and prehashed ECDSA are approximations for the replay signed transcripts. Message-length scaling and ECDSA hashing/nonce costs are not measured.
Operating system scheduling, other onboard workloads, energy, thermal behavior, fault tolerance and certification are outside these timings.
Using this profile for ground verification represents a constrained embedded receiver; it does not describe a modern ground server.
Key generation is recorded separately and is not charged per signature; public-key provisioning and certificate checks need a separate model.

ECDSA-P256.limitation: Same P-256 parameters, different implementation from Python cryptography. Published rounded times; message hashing and nonce generation are external to the API and not included. Original message length and run sample count not stated.
ECDSA-P256.platform: Nordic nRF52840 Cortex-M4; instruction cache enabled
ECDSA-P256.timing_scope: ECDSA arithmetic over a supplied digest; signing nonce generation and original-message hashing excluded.

memory.scope: Library author reports at most 2 kB stack; not a per-operation full system memory measurement.

ML-DSA-44.limitation: ML-DSA-44 parameter set; embedded implementation differs from project liboqs. Timing distribution unavailable; repeated mean is only a constant-service baseline.
ML-DSA-44.platform: ARM Cortex-M4; table does not name the measured board; repository default is NUCLEO-L4R5ZI
ML-DSA-44.compiler_flags: Not specified with the published table; do not infer flags for this run.
ML-DSA-44.timing_scope: crypto_sign / crypto_sign_open calls on 59-byte messages; fixed service-time approximation for other lengths; not this project liboqs wrapper.

memory.scope: Stack inside operation only; excludes caller key, signature and message buffers. Not total process RAM.

assumed_receiver_1ms.platform: Abstract verification server; no physical processor or benchmark claimed
limitations: All algorithms receive the same assumed 1 ms verification time to isolate receiver-capacity sensitivity.
This is neither a measured host benchmark nor an aircraft/server feasibility claim.
Signing and key generation are intentionally unavailable.
